items.description: Close wall opening and repaint affected area
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and repainting the disturbed wall area. Estimate €390 gross for the combined closure and painting.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge on the building-services invoice. One flat charge at the reference rate is €81.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers minor consumables used to seal the repaired water line. One billed unit is estimated at €18 gross.
Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.7(c) cover the first documented replacement section, subject to the pre-loss specification. One metre at a gross trade rate of €48 gives €48.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers reinstatement of the insulation on the repaired pipe to its pre-loss standard. One metre is estimated at €22 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers installer labour for the pipe repair. The invoiced hour at the supplied rate of €63 gives €63.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes the contractor's own measuring device, even though necessary diagnostic work is covered under 7.1.7(e). If payable as qualifying hire, one deployment is estimated at €20.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers the first technician labour entry for the covered work. The supplied gross threshold for the full nine hours is €425.
Section 7.1.7(f) pays only the first travel charge on this contractor's invoice, even when another visit was necessary. The conditional rate for one charge is €81.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover one equipment deployment for necessary drying before the wall is closed. The photo shows one portable air mover; estimate €75 gross for the flat charge.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes contractor blades as tool overhead. The conditional estimate for one blade is €15 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers fittings used to reconnect the repaired pipe. Two fittings at an estimated €39 each give €78 gross.
Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude duplicate material and material not attributable to the documented repair. No separate second section is established; if substantiated, one metre would be €48 gross.
Sections 7.1.8(c) and (d) exclude a second insulation charge where no distinct insulated section is documented beyond line 5. If separately substantiated, one metre would be €22 gross.

Section 7.1.8(c) excludes duplicate labour; this repeats line 8 without identifying separate work, although the claim notes multiple visits. If supported as distinct labour, the full nine-hour threshold is €425.
